# Forgeplan

> Local-first CLI + MCP server that turns architectural decisions into first-class artifacts with quality scoring (R_eff), evidence tracking, lifecycle states, and semantic search. Built for engineering teams who want to stop relitigating the same choices every six months.

## Core

- [Home](https://forgeplan.dev/): Product overview, quickstart, and install instructions
- [Guides — 19 interactive lessons](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/): Decision-logging, DDR/ADR format, Trust Calculus, AI-agent harness engineering
- [Blog — long-form](https://forgeplan.dev/blog/): Essays on engineering decisions, evidence scoring, and AI-agent context

## Getting Started

- [Installation](https://forgeplan.dev/docs/getting-started/installation): brew, cargo, or scripted install
- [Quick Start](https://forgeplan.dev/docs/getting-started/quick-start): From `forgeplan init` to first activated PRD in 5 minutes
- [Configuration](https://forgeplan.dev/docs/getting-started/configuration): config.yaml and LLM provider setup

## Methodology

- [Overview](https://forgeplan.dev/docs/methodology/overview): How the artifact-driven workflow composes
- [Routing & Depth](https://forgeplan.dev/docs/methodology/routing): One question that decides ceremony level (Tactical / Standard / Deep / Critical)
- [Artifact Lifecycle](https://forgeplan.dev/docs/methodology/lifecycle): draft → active → terminal states
- [Evidence & Scoring](https://forgeplan.dev/docs/methodology/evidence): R_eff weakest-link calculus, why averaging trust is wrong
- [ADI Reasoning](https://forgeplan.dev/docs/methodology/adi): Abduction → Deduction → Induction for non-trivial decisions
- [Hint Contract](https://forgeplan.dev/docs/methodology/agent-protocol): Every CLI/MCP output emits `Next:` / `Or:` / `Wait:` / `Done.` / `Fix:` markers

## Selected Guides

- [What a decision log is](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/intro): Six mandatory fields, ADR/DDR formats, who needs one
- [DDR format with full example](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/ddr-format): DDR vs ADR, six mandatory fields, JWT vs sessions example
- [Trust Calculus: F/G/R axes](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/trust-calculus-overview): Weakest-link rule, R_eff formula, context-level penalty
- [Trust Calculus in 3D](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/trust-calculus): Interactive 3D F/G/R scene with seven evidence points
- [ADI as a daily practice](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/adi-overview): Three-version analysis, when to apply
- [Lifecycle: draft to terminal](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/lifecycle-cycle): State machine, stale as forgotten state, renew/reopen
- [Hint Contract — 5 markers](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/agent-protocol-cycle): Next/Or/Wait/Done/Fix rules for agent tools
- [Multi-agent coordination](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/multi-agent-cycle): Dispatch/claim/release, conflict-free buckets, WIP=1
- [Forgeplan as operational layer](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/forgeplan-cycle): CLI + MCP + artifact DAG, four depth levels
- [First Artifact — hands-on walkthrough](https://forgeplan.dev/guides/first-artifact): Simulated terminal: init → activate in 20 minutes
